products.title: Roaster's Choice Coffee Subscription
products.body_html:
Exceptional coffees delivered to you every month.

Here's how the subscription works:

  • Our subscription includes subscriber-exclusive coffees. You'll receive a carefully curated selection of coffees from our green buyer and roaster.
  • Subscription boxes are shipped on the first Thursday of every month. Make sure to sign up before the 28th to receive the following month's box!
  • Missed the cutoff? Not a problem! You can still sign up now to reserve your spot for the next drop.
  • Upon signing up, you'll be charged for your first box immediately, and subsequent orders will be charged on the 28th of every month.
  • You'll keep receiving coffees as long as you want to and you can cancel your subscription at any time.
  • Select your subscription bag quantity of 2, 3, or 4 bags per month.
  • Need your coffee ground? No problem, just be sure to make the appropriate selection below the bag quantity option.
  • All bags are 12 oz.

products.title: Zing
products.body_html:
Named in honor of our old friend Sam and his trailblazing cold brew company Uel Zing, our Zing blend is the prefect combo of two of the flavors we love most in a cold brew and espresso: rich chocolate and dark fruit. Whether you brew the Zing Blend as an espresso, cold brew, or in your classic drip coffee machine, you can count on a rich and sweet complexity with a focus on balance. This one won’t ever let you down.

This coffee is part of our ARC SERIES. These coffees feature a slightly heavier roast profile, perfect for fans of traditional dark roasts.

Zing Blend was awarded two Bronze medals at the 2019 Golden Bean Competition in Nashville, TN in both the Espresso (short black) and Milk-Based (latte) categories!

products.title: Arc
products.body_html:
We originally crafted the ARC Blend as a perfect choice for wholesale customers with super-automatic espresso machines in their cafes, but the feedback we’ve received has been so amazing that we wanted to give everyone the chance to enjoy it!

The ARC Blend has the perfect traditional espresso flavor profile, dark chocolate, caramel & hazelnut. We roast this coffee slightly heavier than our other coffees, but don’t worry…. no oily beans here. Only perfectly roasted, full-bodied flavor that tastes just as great as a drip coffee as it does on an espresso machine. Give it a shot today, it might just be your new favorite!

This coffee is part of our ARC SERIES. These coffees feature a slightly heavier roast profile, perfect for fans of traditional dark roasts.

products.title: Adventurous Sample Pack
products.body_html:
Our Adventurous Sample Pack gives you the chance to try three 4oz bags of our favorite single origin coffees that feature more modern flavor profiles like bright fruit, florals, and candy sugar sweetness.

These coffees are perfect for the person that prefers more unique flavor profiles and appreciate exploring the boundaries of coffee. The Adventurous Sample Pack is a great way to explore our single origin coffees and make an awesome gift!

products.title: Ethiopia - Demeka Becha Layered Ferment
products.body_html:
REGION: Sidama
PRODUCER: Ayele Tulu
PROCESS: Layered Ferment (dry)
VARIETY: Mixed: 74/158, 74/165, 74/112, 74/110, 74/40
ELEVATION: 2100-2200 MASL
TASTING NOTES: Peach tea, cider, fresh citrus

Producer Story

High in Bona Zuria, Sidama, the Demeka Becha washing station is owned by Ayele Tulu and managed by his son, Tsegab Ayele. At the heart of the family is Genet Haile Endeshow, Ayele's wife and Tsegab's mother, whose warmth and hospitality are woven into the family, their home, and the coffee-producing sites they operate.

Situated at the top of a hill, Demeka Becha benefits from steady airflow across its drying beds. The station buys cherries from communities throughout the surrounding Sidama region, where close to 10,000 producers farm the nearby hillsides. On arrival, cherries are weighed, logged, and floated for density before heading to the pulper. We're grateful to the Tulu family for the opportunity to roast and share this coffee, and to Swift for the introduction.

The Process

This coffee undergoes a proprietary Layered Ferment process built around meticulous sorting and carefully staggered fermentation. Ripe cherries are hand sorted for consistent color, floated for density, and hand sorted again before being pulped, creating a remarkably uniform starting point.

Over roughly three days, freshly pulped parchment is layered into a 10,000-kilogram fermentation tank in stages, with no water added at any point, making this a dry ferment. Because each layer goes in on a different day, the coffee at the bottom ferments the longest while the upper layers ferment progressively less, producing several distinct degrees of fermentation within a single tank. Holding that range in balance takes exceptional attention across the entire cycle.

Once fermentation is complete, the parchment moves directly to shaded raised beds. There, gentle sunlight and consistent airflow allow the coffee to dry slowly and evenly until it reaches its target moisture level.

The Cup

Layered fermentation produces an expressive and complex interpretation of Sidama, using different degrees of fermentation to build depth while careful sorting and controlled drying maintain balance and structure. Expect peach tea up front, with cider and fresh citrus carrying through a clean finish.

The result is a coffee shaped by experimentation and precision alike, a distinctive process that builds on the character of the region while exploring just how much careful fermentation can bring to the final cup.

products.title: Decaf - Colombia Huila EA
products.body_html:
REGION: Huila
PRODUCER: Various smallholders
PROCESS: Washed; sugarcane E.A.
VARIETY: Various
ELEVATION: 1500-2000M
TASTING NOTES: Citrus, cocoa powder, plum

This Colombian decaf employs the sugarcane process, a natural decaffeination method that sets it apart from conventional approaches. The process utilizes ethyl acetate, a compound derived from fermented sugarcane molasses, to gently remove caffeine while preserving the coffee's inherent characteristics.

Colombia has emerged as the global leader in sugarcane decaffeination, combining the country's deep coffee expertise with abundant sugarcane production to create a sustainable, chemical-free processing method. The green coffee beans undergo a careful cycle of soaking and steaming in a sugarcane-based ethyl acetate solution. This cycle is repeated multiple times to extract approximately 97% of the caffeine content while maintaining the bean's structural integrity.

Following decaffeination, the beans are thoroughly cleaned, steamed, and dried to prepare them for roasting. No ethyl acetate residue remains in the finished product. The meticulous nature of this process ensures that the coffee's natural sweetness and complexity survive intact, delivering a decaf experience that honors the coffee's origin character.

The Cup

The result is a balanced and vibrant decaf that defies expectations. The cup profile showcases bright notes of citrus fruit, complemented by the richness of cocoa powder and the subtle depth of plum. This is a comforting, full-flavored coffee that delivers genuine complexity—just without the caffeine.
